basic_details.job_title: KUFOS Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 2 Faculty and Marine Biology Faculty Posts
basic_details.post_name: Contract Faculty - Marine Biology, Contract Faculty - Marine Biology with experience in Marine Biotechnology
basic_details.short_information: Kerala University of Fisheries and Ocean Studies (KUFOS), Kochi, has invited applications for 2 posts in 2 roles under Advt No. GA5/12495/2026 (i). The posts include Contract Faculty - Marine Biology, Contract Faculty - Marine Biology with experience in Marine Biotechnology. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 4 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online transfer to A/c No. 67149674791, Finance Officer, KUFOS, SBI, SA Road, Vyttila, IFSC SBIN0070517.

age_limit.age_details: Maximum 50 years (as on the date of this notification)
age_limit.details: Age relaxation for all posts: Age relaxation will be applicable as per Government Rules.

qualification.education_qualification: Master's Degree in the specified Marine Biology/allied subjects with minimum 55% marks or equivalent grade from a recognized University plus NET (UGC/CSIR/ASRB or equivalent), OR PhD in the relevant discipline in accordance with UGC Regulations.

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: Master's Degree in Marine Biology/ Fisheries Biology & Aquaculture/Aquatic Biology & Fisheries/Marine Sciences with minimum 55% marks or equivalent grade from a recognized University; NET qualification in the relevant subject conducted by UGC/CSIR/ASRB or equivalent national eligibility test; OR PhD in the relevant discipline in accordance with UGC Regulations. Experience required: Desirable: Minimum 3 years of teaching/research experience at postgraduate or undergraduate level in Marine Biology. Age limit: Maximum 50 years. Pay: Rs. 80,000 per Month. Qualification required: Master's Degree in Marine Biology/ Marine Biotechnology/ Marine Biology with Biotechnology with minimum 55% marks or equivalent grade from a recognized University; NET qualification in the relev

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 80,000 per Month (consolidated) for both posts

how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application format from www.kufos.ac.in (also attached to the notification).
Pay the application fee online to the Finance Officer, KUFOS account (SBI, SA Road, Vyttila; A/c 67149674791; IFSC SBIN0070517).
Enclose biodata, self-attested supporting documents with marklist and proof of remitting the fee.
Superscribe the envelope with the advertisement number and the post applied for.
Send so that it reaches The Registrar, KUFOS, Panangad P.O, Madavana, Kochi-682 506 on or before 4.30 pm, 04.12.2026.
important_instructions: Fee once paid shall not be refunded University not responsible for postal delay University reserves the right not to fill any or all posts and to draw reserve panels No interim queries regarding test/interview/selection will be entertained

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for KUFOS Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Other conditions: Prescribed qualification shall be as on the last date for receipt of application Candidates applying for both posts must remit the application fee separately for each post Desirable: Post 1: Specialization in Marine Biodiversity, Marine Taxonomy, Reef Ecology or Fish Biology; publications in Marine Biology Post 1: Minimum 3 years teaching/research experience at PG or UG level in Marine Biology; research in marine ecosystems, biodiversity, fishery biology Post 1: Field survey/underwater assessment experience; certified SCUBA diver (minimum PADI Rescue Diver and EFR-CPR & AED) Post 2: Specialization in Marine Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, Marine Microbiology, Genomics, Proteomics, Bioinformatics or allied areas Post 2: Minimum 3 years teaching/research experience at PG or UG level in Marine Biotechnology or allied subjects; publications in Marine Biotechnology Post 2: Hands-on molecular biology/biotechnology techniques; laboratory management and advanced analytical and molecular instrumentation

Experience required: Desirable: Minimum 3 years of teaching/research experience at postgraduate or undergraduate level in Marine Biology. Age limit: Maximum 50 years. Pay: Rs. 80,000 per Month. Pay: Rs. 80,000 per Month.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for KUFOS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in KUFOS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Contract Faculty - Marine Biology, 1 Contract Faculty - Marine Biology with experience in Marine Biotechnology.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for KUFOS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed format on www.kufos.ac.in, attached to the notification (pages 5-6)) and send it to The Registrar, Kerala University of Fisheries and Ocean Studies, Panangad P.O, Madavana, Kochi-682 506, by post or delivery so that it reaches the registrar by the deadline, to reach by 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates other than SC/ST: Rs. 2000. SC/ST Candidates: Rs. 500.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 50 years (as on the date of this notification). Relaxation: Age relaxation will be applicable as per Government Rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 80,000 per Month for Contract Faculty - Marine Biology, Rs. 80,000 per Month for Contract Faculty - Marine Biology with experience in Marine Biotechnology.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's Degree in the specified Marine Biology/allied subjects with minimum 55% marks or equivalent grade from a recognized University plus NET (UGC/CSIR/ASRB or equivalent), OR PhD in the relevant discipline in accordance with UGC Regulations. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Prescribed qualification shall be as on the last date for receipt of application. Candidates applying for both posts must remit the application fee separately for each post.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications not in the prescribed format, without fee or supporting documents will be summarily rejected. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting on the basis of qualifications/experience, at the University's discretion, when applications are many. Interview. Mere possession of essential qualifications does not entitle candidates to be called for interview. University may restrict the number of candidates called on the basis of qualifications/experience.
